definitions.explanation: A portion of the total price paid before the goods or services are delivered, with the balance settled later. Unlike a deposit securing a contract, it counts directly against the amount owed.

examples.english: I put down a part payment.

examples.japanese: {代金|だいきん}の{半分|はんぶん}を{内金|うちきん}として{払|はら}った。
examples.english: I paid half the price as a part payment.

examples.japanese: {内金|うちきん}を{受|う}け{取|と}った{時点|じてん}で、{商品|しょうひん}を{確保|かくほ}しておきます。
examples.english: We will set the item aside as soon as we receive the part payment.

notes:
Money paid toward a price before delivery. The amount is deducted from the final bill, so it is always part of the price rather than an extra charge.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内金|うちきん}を{入|い}れる: to put down a part payment
- {内金|うちきん}を{払|はら}う: to pay part of the price up front
- {内金|うちきん}として: as a part payment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手付金|てつけきん}: deposit — secures a contract and can be forfeited if the buyer withdraws
- {頭金|あたまきん}: down payment — the first, larger payment in an installment purchase
- {前払金|まえばらいきん}: advance payment — money paid ahead of delivery, often the full amount
